boardsLead: Find your board, check how it connects, and bring your climbing history where imports are supported.
nativeLights: Light climbs from the iOS or Android app.
noLights: Holds appear on your photo. No lights or controller needed.
noImport: Account imports are not available for this board.
controller: Kilter and Tension connect to one phone at a time. MoonBoard V3 and newer controllers allow several; the original controller keeps the first phone. Other controllers vary: check the connection guide.
platforms: Browse in your browser. Use the iOS or Android app to connect to a board and light holds.
checked: Capabilities checked against the app on 18 November 2026.
sprayTitle: Your spray wall, set and logged.
sprayLead: Take one photo. Boardsesh finds the holds, you fix any it missed, and your crew sets and logs climbs on it. Free for home and gym walls.
sprayStep3: Set a climb with your crew
sprayPrivacy: Choose Private, Link only or Public when publishing. Members of a gym can also see private walls attached to that gym. Change visibility under Edit board.
sprayTraining: Help train hold finding is on by default. Switch it off under Edit board. This permission lets Boardsesh use the photo to improve hold finding; it does not make a private wall public.
sprayNoLights: No lights needed: the holds show on your photo.
forGymsTitle: Your board wall, easier for members.
forGymsLead: Members queue and light climbs together from their own phones, then log their sends. It costs your gym nothing.
membersBody: Everyone picks climbs on their own phone. One connected phone lights a Kilter or Tension board, so the crew can share the wall.
staffBody: Claim your gym to edit its boards, angles, hours and links. Listings come from public board-location data and from climbers.
kioskBody: A kiosk display can show the current climb and shared queue. Ask us about setting up a screen at your wall.
privacyBody: Each climber uses their own account and can export their climbing data. Claiming a listing does not give staff access to private logbooks.
partnerBody: Want a connected wall without building an app? Tell us about your layout. For a home build, ask us what is supported before buying hardware.
importTitle: Bring your Kilter or Tension logbook
importBody: Link your account once. Boardsesh checks for new sends in the background. Timing varies; nothing is written back to their apps.
gymBody: Claim your listing to set the boards, angles and hours climbers see.
trust: Free. Open source. Export your logbook any time.
proofNote: Counts times a climb stayed lit for about a minute, including repeats.
directorySearch: Search for a gym or town
moonboardImport: Import a MoonBoard CSV file in Connected apps. Nothing is written back to MoonBoard.
legacyImport: Used the old Kilter app? Upload your Aurora export file.
auroraImport: Link an account where available in Connected apps, or upload an Aurora export file. Imports copy history into Boardsesh; nothing is written back.
